$comment: PASAbi design tokens. Source of truth for every color, size, space and radius. Values are mirrored by hand into src/theme/tokens.ts (React Native has no AEGIS export target); keep the two identical.

Traces: team: = a value the existing screens already used on purpose; delegated: = picked by AEGIS on 2026-09-27 because the lead asked for the skills to be run to improve the output, with no time for design questions. Change any.
Light only this round (see DESIGN_BRIEF.md section 7). No dark mode block on purpose.

bg.$description: delegated: the grey every existing screen already renders on (React Navigation's default background), now set explicitly in the navigation theme so it is a decision, not an accident. Keeps white cards visibly separate on the board

surface.$description: delegated: incident cards, panels, the QR frame. White so a card reads as one unit on the grey page

surface-raised.$description: team: the secondary-button fill already used in station.tsx

surface-hover.$description: team: the selected-category tint already used on the report form

text-primary.$description: delegated: near-black for headlines and numbers; 15.9:1 on bg

text-secondary.$description: team: the muted grey used across the existing screens; 5.2:1 on bg

text-on-accent.$description: team: button label on the blue accent; 5.7:1

border.$description: delegated: input and control edges. Replaces #c3cad2, which was 1.65:1 and failed the 3:1 minimum for a field's boundary (WCAG 1.4.11)

border-subtle.$description: team: card dividers only. Decorative, never the only edge of an input

accent.$description: team: the blue the app already leads with (primary buttons, links, 'new' flag). Kept: it carries no alarm meaning, which matters on a board where red and amber must stay reserved for escalation and uncertainty

accent-hover.$description: team: the darker blue already used for the score number; pressed state

success.$description: team: RESERVED for 'resolved' and explicit safe check-ins. Never for coverage or sources, so green is never read as 'this area is fine' (BR-017)

warning.$description: delegated: uncertainty: stale, aging, limited coverage, not yet reported, newly corroborated flag. Darkened from #8a6d1f, which was 4.37:1 on bg and failed as text

danger.$description: team: escalated flag and real errors only

qr-dark.$description: delegated: QR modules. Never themed; scanners need maximum contrast

qr-light.$description: delegated: QR background and quiet zone

display.$description: delegated: the platform system face (SF Pro on iPhone). Reason: an offline disaster app should not depend on a downloaded font, SF Pro has full Filipino coverage and tabular figures for counts and times, and iPhone users already read it fastest. One family on purpose; hierarchy comes from size and weight

caption.$description: delegated: badges, timestamps, secondary lines. Consolidates the existing 11, 12, 13 and 14

body.$description: delegated: body and buttons. Consolidates 15, 16 and 17

h3.$description: delegated: card titles and the score. Consolidates 18 and 20; ratio 1.25

1.$description: delegated: 4px grid, the base the existing screens mostly used

4.$description: team: page padding already in use

7.$description: team: page bottom padding already in use

fast.$description: delegated: state feedback only (a badge changing, a frame counter ticking)

base.$description: delegated: screen transitions are the navigator's own

md.$description: delegated: the dashboard switches to two columns (list + detail) at tablet width and up; phones are single column
